skills.name: dxf-analyzer
skills.description: Analyzes DXF files (Drawing Exchange Format / AutoCAD): extracts geometric entities (LINE, ARC, CIRCLE, TEXT, INSERT, DIMENSION…), layers, blocks, metadata and statistics. Takes the chat attachment id as input (file-ref: the backend authorizes the file and copies it into the container). Always saves a full JSON report to file; stdout returns only a lightweight summary with download_url. Supports all DXF versions (R10–R2018).
skills.author: info@rstonline.it

skills.name: ascii-art
skills.description: Generates ASCII art in various styles: text banners with 571 fonts (pyfiglet), speech bubbles with animal characters (cowsay/cowthink), decorative frames (boxes), prebuilt art for common subjects, QR codes, ASCII weather and image → ASCII art conversion.
skills.author: info@rstonline.it

skills.name: pdf-generator-html
skills.description: Generates professional A4 PDFs from HTML via Puppeteer (headless Chromium). Supports full HTML/CSS: styled tables, headers, lists, inline styles. Ideal for quotes, reports, invoices. Returns absolute file_path for inter-skill use (e.g. Gmail attachments).
skills.author: info@rstonline.it

skills.name: gmail
skills.description: Full Gmail integration. Sends, reads, lists, replies to and forwards email via the official Google Gmail API with OAuth2. Supports outgoing attachments (send, reply, forward) with automatic MIME detection. Includes a real-time monitoring daemon (watch via History API) that instantly push-notifies the backend when new email arrives in the INBOX; polling interval configurable via GMAIL_POLL_INTERVAL.
skills.author: info@rstonline.it

skills.name: als-recommender
skills.description: Collaborative Filtering via ALS (Alternating Least Squares): trains models on CSV data and provides seed- or session-based recommendations, item-item cosine similarity, KMeans cluster profiles, anomaly detection and cold-start fallback. Supports implicit, explicit and biased variants. Callable as an ML service from other skills via the inter-skill bus.
skills.author: info@rstonline.it

skills.name: telegram-bot
skills.description: Connects Arkimede to Telegram, bidirectionally. Each Arkimede user can link their account to the bot and chat with the AI just like from the web interface — with access to tools, MCP, RAG and skills. The agent can also proactively send Telegram messages and files to the linked user (send_message tool) from any chat, scheduled task or flow. Supports multi-user, automatic attachment delivery and sessions persisted in the DB.
skills.author: info@rstonline.it

skills.name: files
skills.description: Unified file management across all user locations: the local filesystem (SKILLS_OUTPUT_DIR) and network shares (SMB/CIFS-Samba, SFTP, WebDAV) configured as file-share DataSources. Search (automatic fan-out across all sources), read (text in chat, attach as download, or index into the vector store), write and delete. All I/O goes through the internal backend endpoint.
skills.author: info@rstonline.it

skills.name: coverage-check
skills.description: Analyzes functional coverage of elements against configurable zones. Supports multiple profiles, contextual required_if conditions and keyword matching. Optional integration with als-recommender for ML suggestions, per-zone anomaly detection and cluster profiles.
skills.author: info@rstonline.it

skills.name: knx
skills.description: Controls a KNX home-automation installation through a KNX/IP gateway (router or interface): switches lights, drives dimmers, shutters, scenes and thermostat setpoints via group-address writes, reads sensor/actuator state, monitors live bus traffic and discovers KNX/IP gateways on the LAN. Supports a configurable friendly-name map and all KNX datapoint types. Requires a granted LAN network (KNXnet/IP is UDP and cannot pass the HTTP egress proxy).
skills.author: info@rstonline.it
